subject.title: fix(cli): reject --channel/--to for systemEvent cron jobs with a clear error

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally replace the previously accepted-but-ignored chat-delivery flags on main-session system-event cron jobs with this immediate CLI error?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and consistent across add and edit, but it changes the outcome for existing scripts from a silently ineffective job to a hard failure; that compatibility contract is a maintainer choice.

options.title: Accept fail-fast validation
options.body: Merge the PR and treat explicit chat-delivery flags on unsupported main-session system-event jobs as invalid CLI input.

options.title: Preserve acceptance temporarily
options.body: Keep the current behavior only if maintainers want a documented migration or an alternate supported delivery workflow before introducing the error.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-fast validation
recommendation.body: Merge the PR and treat explicit chat-delivery flags on unsupported main-session system-event jobs as invalid CLI input.
